headline: Dunmore Logistics signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Dunmore Logistics announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.

headline: Regulators open inquiry into Dunmore Logistics labeling practices
body: A regulator opened an inquiry into product labeling at Dunmore Logistics. The company said it is cooperating and that no violations have been established.

headline: Dunmore Logistics reports minor shipment delays at Curitiba plant
body: Dunmore Logistics confirmed shipment delays of several days at its Curitiba plant due to a equipment maintenance backlog. The company said deliveries should normalize within weeks.

headline: Dunmore Logistics to present at regional manufacturing conference

headline: Dunmore Logistics reports record quarterly revenue
body: Dunmore Logistics reported revenue growth of 19% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Analysts trim outlook for Dunmore Logistics on softer demand
body: Two analysts lowered their outlook for Dunmore Logistics, citing softer demand and rising input costs. No change to guidance has been announced.
